thread:
emma: onboarding Pelican7B (7B) int4. smoke shows a 3-token micro-loop after ~1200 tokens: pattern repeats every 3 tokens. looks quant-specific.

ji: paste tiny repro and quant flags?

emma: repro: python serve.py --model pelican7b --quant int4 --max-tokens 4096 --seed 11. prompt: count 1..2500 then ask. snippet around 1203 shows: 
... 'alpha' 'beta' 'gamma' 'alpha' 'beta' 'gamma' ...

rob: 3-token loop could be head-interleave + rotary pairing mismatch or a pad/sentinel alias shifting token ids by 3. tokenizer differences?

emma: fp16 vocab_size=50260, int4 export vocab_size=50263 (+3). exporter log: appended sentinels <s1>,<s2>,<s3>. remapping to fp16 indices shifts many mid-range ids. when i normalize vocab, loop period changed to ~3600.

ji: grep runtime for any cache keyed on token modulo small primes or using token_id & mask. i recall legacy fast-path used bitmask: slot = token_id & (pool_size-1). if pool_size is power of two, added sentinels cause periodic wraps.

emma: found it in kv_pool.py: slot = token_id & 0x7ff  # fast wrap for 2048 pool. that's bad for longctx.

rob: fix: index by absolute sequence index rather than token id. also add a migration to handle exporters that append sentinels. we'll add a flag --preserve-vocab-order to quant pipeline.

emma: i'll submit a tiny PR to kv_pool and add a regression test: generate 8192 repeating tokens and assert no 3-token periodicity across fp16/int4.

infra-bot: created task ENG-ML-2248 "kv_pool: stop bitmasking by token_id; support sentinel-aware vocab remap (Pelican7B)" assigned to @rob @emma. link: https://tasks.redwood/in/ENG-ML-2248

ji: after PR, run a head-unpack check: ensure interleave packing didn't permute rotary pairs. add per-head cos/sin alignment check in onboarding harness.

emma: tests added on branch pelican/onboard-fix. canary queued. will post results. :thumbsup:
